reports.title: TransUnion Announces Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results

lines: •Increased pace of share repurchases for a total of $243 million year-to-date; expect to repurchase up to $500 million shares total in 2026

Markets revenue +7%* led by Financial Services (+11%, or +5% excluding mortgage) and Emerging Verticals (+6%) Organic constant currency revenue +8% or ~5.5% excluding FICO mortgage royalties Adjusted Diluted EPS +14% Exceeded guidance on revenue, Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted Diluted EPS Repurchased ~$243M in shares year-to-date** Expect ~$500M in repurchases for FY 2026;
